name: fullsuite-regression-r1
written: 2026-10-28, before any patched workspace was run under this rule
motivation: internal pre-submission review: success counted only on bug-revealing tests; test-specific patches may differ by condition.
status: post hoc; offline; no model calls
scope: Every retry (all five conditions) recorded as resolved in planning/m1-main-r1/analysis-final/C.json; resolved first attempts of tasks with failures as context only.

suite.fallback: If either reference run of a task's full roots times out or does not return, use instead the test modules in the directories containing that task's selected tests (protected paths), applied to reference and patched runs alike.
suite.sandbox: Same per-task sandbox spec as the main run (no network, same interpreter and packages).
suite.test_files: Files under the suite roots are taken from the reference (fixed) checkout in both reference and patched runs, so agent edits to unprotected test files cannot hide a regression; such edits are counted and reported.

reference: The task's fixed checkout, run twice. Stable-pass set S = test node ids whose setup, call and teardown phases all passed in both runs.
regression: A patched workspace regresses if any test in S is not passed in all its phases (failed, error, skipped or not collected), or if the run times out or pytest does not return.
outcome: suite_clean = resolved on the selected tests AND no regression. Reported per condition; the primary contrasts are recomputed with suite_clean as outcome using the frozen analysis code paths (paired differences, task-cluster bootstrap, sign-flip permutation, Holm).
no_tuning: Rule is not changed after seeing patched results; any deviation is recorded as an amendment with reason.

amendments.when: 2026-10-28, after the first reference (fixed-checkout) runs and before any patched workspace was run
amendments.what: Test modules under the roots are passed to pytest as an explicit file list (names test*.py, *_test.py, *_tests.py) and --continue-on-collection-errors is set.
amendments.why: Directory arguments collected nothing for tqdm/httpie (non-default file names) and one optional-dependency import error (e.g. PIL, urllib3) aborted collection of whole suites. Modules that fail to import on the fixed checkout contribute no stable-pass tests.
amendments.effect: Reference runs repeated from scratch; rule content unchanged.

amendments.when: 2026-10-29 PDT, after all reference runs and before any patched workspace was run
amendments.what: (a) A run counts as returned when pytest itself returned (lifecycle state "returned"), even if the process was killed at the timeout afterwards (luigi/3 and luigi/9: pytest finished in about 8 minutes, then the interpreter hung on exit in both reference runs). (b) A task whose reference runs did not return in either mode has no stable-pass set; its resolved attempts are reported as "not checked" (luigi/23: S3 tests stall without network).
amendments.why: Applying the rule literally would count every patched luigi run as a regression because of a shutdown hang that also occurs on the fixed checkout.
amendments.implementation: m1/fullsuite_summary.py (m1/fullsuite.py is unchanged; it is hashed in the frozen M2 scope).
